description: This file handles dynamic loading and rendering of syntax-highlighted code blocks, mathematical formulas via KaTeX, and diagram rendering via Mermaid in a webpage. It uses DOM APIs to select code blocks and dynamically loads libraries to process them.

methods.name: loadCSS
methods.description: Loads a CSS file into the document.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Loads a JavaScript file dynamically, executes callback on load.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Executes a callback once DOM is fully loaded.
